description: Update the root README.md with entries for new or changed agent companies. Use when a new company has been added to the repo, when company details have changed (agents added/removed, skills added/removed), or when the user asks to refresh/sync the README. Triggers on: "update the readme", "add this company to the readme", "sync readme", "refresh readme", or after creating a new company with company-creator.
